biotools.summary: CoVpipe2 is a bioinformatics workflow developed by the Robert Koch Institute to accurately reconstruct SARS-CoV-2 genomes from short-read sequencing data, addressing common challenges like primer clipping and mixed samples. It's written in Nextflow and freely accessible under the GPL3 license.
